summary: the time and the number of steps a run needs for a particle of a given diffusivity to move a stated multiple of a size, by its mean squared displacement

inputs.name: diffusivity
inputs.meaning: the diffusivity of the slowest particle the run must follow

inputs.name: size
inputs.meaning: the size the displacement is counted in, a particle's diameter for one

inputs.name: multiple
inputs.meaning: how many sizes the root mean squared displacement is to reach

inputs.name: dimensions
inputs.meaning: how many dimensions the particle moves in

outputs.name: run_time
outputs.meaning: (multiple x size)^2 over 2 x dimensions x diffusivity

outputs.name: steps
outputs.meaning: the run time over the time step, rounded up

validity: normal diffusion at the lags the run reaches; the root mean squared displacement, which a single particle may fall short of or exceed

source.locus: Derivation for n dimensions: MSD = 2nDt, n the number of dimensions

note: No value of the source stands behind the worked cases: each is worked by hand in its worked field.
